# PostFast

> PostFast is a social media scheduling platform that helps users save 10+ hours weekly by efficiently managing and automating content publishing across multiple platforms from one centralized dashboard.

PostFast enables content creators, brands, and businesses to schedule posts across major social networks including X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, BlueSky, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Telegram, and Google Business Profile. The platform features a clean, intuitive interface designed to streamline social media management workflows.

## Core Features

- [Scheduling](https://postfa.st/#features): Schedule your content in advance across multiple platforms simultaneously with true automation
- [Platform Support](https://postfa.st/#integration): Connect and manage 11 platforms: X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, BlueSky, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Telegram, and Google Business Profile
- [X Features](https://postfa.st/integration/x): Carousel posts (up to 4 images), auto-retweet, retweet by URL
- [LinkedIn](https://postfa.st/integration/linkedin): Personal profiles and company pages support. Documents (PDFs, PowerPoint, Word). Analytics for Pages only
- [Pinterest](https://postfa.st/integration/pinterest): Pins, carousel pins (2-5 images), video pins, and board management
- [Google Business Profile](https://postfa.st/integration/google-business-profile): Standard updates, events, and offers with call-to-action buttons. 1 image (JPEG/PNG), multi-location support
- [Calendar View](https://postfa.st/#features): Visual calendar interface for planning and organizing your content strategy
- [Workspaces & Teams](https://postfa.st/#features): Collaborate with team members and manage multiple client accounts
- [Approval Workflows](https://postfa.st/#features): Review and approve content before publishing for better quality control
- [Carousels](https://postfa.st/#features): Create multi-image posts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, and X
- [First Comment](https://postfa.st/#features): Automatically post a first comment ~10 seconds after publishing. Supported on X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, and TikTok
- [Canva Integration](https://postfa.st/roadmap): Import designs directly from Canva into PostFast without leaving the app
- [Dropbox Integration](https://postfa.st/roadmap): Import files directly from Dropbox into PostFast without leaving the app
- [Video Generation](https://postfa.st/#features): Generate videos from images and sound for social media
- [Mobile Apps](https://postfa.st/): Native iOS and Android apps for managing social media on the go
- [Analytics](https://postfa.st/features/analytics): Limited Analytics (Starter), full Analytics (Creator+). Full support: Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest (Business accounts). LinkedIn Pages only. Data auto-updates every 6 hours for 2 weeks, then daily. Pinterest saves are 90-day rolling (Pinterest API limitation).
- [API Access](https://postfa.st/docs): Full REST API for custom integrations and automation. Connected accounts report a connection status (CONNECTED/DISABLED) so you can detect when one needs reconnecting, plus a daily follower/subscriber count and day-by-day follower growth history (GET /social-media/:id/follower-history). Post analytics include video watch-time (average and total watch seconds, plus video views) on supported platforms. Search real-world places to geotag Facebook/Instagram posts, and limit a Facebook post's audience by country. Machine-readable Markdown twin of the full reference at https://postfa.st/docs.md
- [ChatGPT Connector](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/chatgpt): Hosted MCP connector for ChatGPT. Draft, schedule, and publish to 11 platforms from inside ChatGPT over secure OAuth (no API key). Add the connector URL https://mcp.postfa.st/mcp in ChatGPT. Requires a paid ChatGPT plan with Developer mode.
- [Claude Connector](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/claude): Hosted MCP connector for the Claude app (web and desktop). Draft, schedule, and publish to 11 platforms from inside Claude over secure OAuth (no API key). Add the connector URL https://mcp.postfa.st/mcp in Claude. Works on Claude Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise.
- [MCP Server](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/mcp): Official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI tools and IDEs. Schedule posts from Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and any MCP-compatible tool using natural language. Install via `npx postfast-mcp`. Ships 13 tools.
- [Claude Code Integration](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/claude-code): CLI-first walkthrough for Claude Code users. Schedule Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube posts from the terminal.
- [NanoClaw Integration](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/nanoclaw): Message your container-isolated AI agent on WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, or Gmail. Runs inside Docker Sandboxes (MicroVM isolation), per-group API key isolation for agencies.
- [OpenClaw Integration](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/openclaw): Schedule posts from WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and 50+ chat apps via OpenClaw AI assistant. Install via `clawhub install postfast`
- [API Integrations Hub](https://postfa.st/api-integrations): Compare the ChatGPT and Claude hosted connectors, Claude Code, NanoClaw, MCP Server, OpenClaw, n8n, Zapier, and Make integrations.
- [n8n / Zapier / Make](https://postfa.st/api-integrations/n8n): Pre-built workflow templates for n8n (verified community node), Zapier, and Make

## Pricing

- [Starter Plan](https://postfa.st/pricing): €10/mo annual (€12/mo monthly) - 4 social accounts, 150 scheduled posts, 1 workspace, Limited Analytics, API access
- [Creator Plan](https://postfa.st/pricing): €24/mo annual (€29/mo monthly) - 12 social accounts, 1,500 scheduled posts, 4 workspaces, Analytics, team collaboration
- [Growth Plan](https://postfa.st/pricing): €40/mo annual (€49/mo monthly) - 30 social accounts, 3,000 scheduled posts, 10 workspaces, Analytics, team collaboration
- [Pro Plan](https://postfa.st/pricing): €82.50/mo annual (€99/mo monthly) - 120 social accounts, unlimited posts, 30 workspaces, Analytics, priority support
- [Enterprise Plan](https://postfa.st/pricing): €199/mo annual (€239/mo monthly) - 500 social accounts, unlimited posts, 110 workspaces, Analytics, priority support
- [Free Trial](https://postfa.st/pricing): 7-day free trial on all plans with full feature access
- Annual billing saves you 2 months (~17-18%) on every tier compared to monthly billing

## Free Tools

- [Free Tools Hub](https://postfa.st/tools): Free, no-signup tools for social media marketers
- [UTM Builder](https://postfa.st/tools/utm-builder): GA4-compliant UTM tracking link generator with channel preview, opinionated source/medium presets for 9 social platforms, and validation against GA4's Default Channel Group rules
- [Social Media Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper): Free in-browser image cropper for 10 social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Telegram). Cropping happens client-side via the Canvas API, so images never leave the user's device. PNG / JPG output with quality slider, exact preset dimensions per platform, no signup, no upload, no watermark
- [Instagram Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/instagram): 1080x1080 square, 1080x1350 portrait, 1080x1920 story / reel
- [TikTok Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/tiktok): 1080x1920 video cover, 1080x1080 Photo Mode carousel slide
- [Facebook Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/facebook): 1080x1080 square post, 820x360 cover photo (safe-zone), 1080x1920 story
- [LinkedIn Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/linkedin): 1200x627 link post, 1200x1200 square, 1584x396 banner, 400x400 profile picture
- [X (Twitter) Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/x): 1200x675 post, 1500x500 header, 400x400 profile picture
- [YouTube Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/youtube): 1280x720 thumbnail, 1920x1080 video frame, 2560x1440 channel art
- [Pinterest Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/pinterest): 1000x1500 standard pin, 1000x1000 square pin, 1080x1920 vertical pin
- [Threads Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/threads): 1080x1920 vertical, 1080x1350 portrait, 1080x1080 square
- [Bluesky Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/bluesky): 1500x500 banner (3:1), 400x400 profile picture
- [Telegram Image Cropper](https://postfa.st/tools/cropper/telegram): 512x512 channel photo, 1280x720 link / video preview

## Alternatives & Comparisons

- [Compare Hub](https://postfa.st/compare): Side-by-side head-to-head comparisons of PostFast against 11 major schedulers including Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, Publer, FeedHive, Loomly, Sprout Social, SocialPilot, Sendible, Postiz, and Metricool.
- [PostFast Alternatives Guide](https://postfa.st/postfast-alternatives): Honest hub page listing 4 alternative guides, when PostFast is NOT the right choice, and when we actually win.
- [Buffer Alternatives](https://postfa.st/buffer-alternatives): 10 alternatives to Buffer covering flat-pricing and free-plan options for teams frustrated with Buffer's per-channel model.
- [Hootsuite Alternatives](https://postfa.st/hootsuite-alternatives): 12 alternatives to Hootsuite's $99-$249 per-user seat pricing, including a dedicated "Free Hootsuite alternatives" subsection.
- [Sprout Social Alternatives](https://postfa.st/sprout-social-alternatives): 11 agency-ready alternatives to Sprout Social's $199-$399 per seat pricing.
- [Loomly Pricing & Alternatives](https://postfa.st/loomly-pricing): Full Loomly tier breakdown ($49-$249/mo annual) plus 6 cheaper alternatives and mini-comparisons against Sprout, Sendible, Later, and SocialPilot.
- [Metricool Alternatives](https://postfa.st/metricool-alternatives): 12 alternatives to Metricool's per-brand bracket pricing for teams who want flat per-account pricing, a real public REST API, no Twitter/X add-on, or a free plan that includes LinkedIn and X.
- [PostFast vs Metricool](https://postfa.st/compare/postfast-vs-metricool): Head-to-head comparison covering Metricool's per-brand pricing model, Twitter/X add-on cost, API gating, analytics depth, and where each tool wins.
